comment: T2 category-rename judge probes (NOTES § Rule-written key). Texts are DeltaDocs rule prose (list number and bold ID are stripped by the judge anyway); CAT-001, CAT-007, TAB-004 are verbatim from c5389db / d0866c9; CAT-007 is also tasks/T2-category-rename/reference.patch's rule.

probes.rule: Renaming or deleting a category only acts on a category of the URL's project — a category ID belonging to another project is treated as not found.

A category rename request is only applied if the category belongs to the project named in the request path; if the ID refers to a category in some other project, the server answers not found and changes nothing.

Every mutation that takes an entity ID from the URL (categories, files, members) must act only on an entity of the URL's project; an ID from another project is treated as not found and nothing changes.
Categories are project-scoped — they cannot be shared across projects.
A tab's page and its category must belong to the same project — creating a tab with a category from another project is rejected.
A role_category_permission's role and category must belong to the same project — setting a permission with a role and category from different projects is rejected.
Any project member may rename a category.
Category mutations must validate the ID.
